_about: Public-domain Francis Xavier (1506-1552, Jesuit missionary to India and Japan) in English for the Word Hoard: Teachings and Counsels of St. Francis Xavier, gathered from his letters (London: Burns and Oates, 1888), from an Internet Archive scan. Coleridge's Life and Letters (1872) is a life with the letters set in it, so it is an alternate. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
